#[path = "ownership.rs"]
mod ownership;
use nix::libc;
use std::io::{BufRead, BufReader, Read, Write};
use std::os::unix::net::UnixStream;
use std::process::{Command, Stdio};
use std::time::Duration;
fn value(name: &str) -> Vec<u8> {
    let s = std::env::var(name).unwrap_or_default();
    assert!(s.len() % 2 == 0);
    (0..s.len())
        .step_by(2)
        .map(|n| u8::from_str_radix(&s[n..n + 2], 16).unwrap())
        .collect()
}
fn main() {
    let label = std::env::var("P1_LABEL").unwrap_or_default();
    let Some((_held, lifetime)) = ownership::register(&label).unwrap() else {
        return;
    };
    let mode = std::env::var("P1_MODE").unwrap_or_default();
    if mode == "inherit" {
        let mut input = Vec::new();
        std::io::stdin().read_to_end(&mut input).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            std::env::current_dir().unwrap(),
            std::path::PathBuf::from(std::env::var_os("P1_EXPECT_CWD").unwrap())
        );
        assert_eq!(std::env::var("P1_SENTINEL").unwrap(), "sentinel-雪");
        assert_eq!(std::env::args_os().count(), 1);
        assert!(input.is_empty())
    }
    if let Ok(path) = std::env::var("P1_READYFILE") {
        if !path.is_empty() {
            while !std::path::Path::new(&path).exists() {
                std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(1))
            }
        }
    }
    if mode == "large" {
        std::io::stdout()
            .write_all(&b"out\0".repeat(65536))
            .unwrap();
        std::io::stderr()
            .write_all(&b"err\n".repeat(65536))
            .unwrap()
    }
    std::io::stdout()
        .write_all(&value("P1_PREFIX_HEX"))
        .unwrap();
    std::io::stdout().flush().unwrap();
    std::io::stderr()
        .write_all(&value("P1_STDERR_HEX"))
        .unwrap();
    std::io::stderr().flush().unwrap();
    if mode.starts_with("descendant") {
        let mut child = Command::new(std::env::current_exe().unwrap());
        child
            .env("P1_MODE", "gate")
            .env("P1_LABEL", format!("{label}.child"))
            .env("P1_PREFIX_HEX", "")
            .env("P1_STDERR_HEX", "")
            .env("P1_PAYLOAD_HEX", "");
        if mode.contains("closed") {
            child.stdout(Stdio::null()).stderr(Stdio::null());
        }
        child.spawn().unwrap();
    }
    let mut connection = UnixStream::connect(std::env::var_os("P1_SOCKET").unwrap()).unwrap();
    writeln!(
        connection,
        "{{\"Label\":{},\"Record\":{},\"PID\":{},\"PPID\":{},\"PGID\":{}}}",
        ownership::quote(&label),
        ownership::quote(&lifetime.record),
        std::process::id(),
        unsafe { libc::getppid() },
        unsafe { libc::getpgrp() }
    )
    .unwrap();
    if mode != "exit" && mode != "large" && mode != "inherit" && !mode.contains("-exit") {
        let mut command = String::new();
        BufReader::new(&connection).read_line(&mut command).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(command, "release\n")
    }
    std::io::stdout()
        .write_all(&value("P1_PAYLOAD_HEX"))
        .unwrap();
    std::io::stdout().flush().unwrap();
    let code = std::env::var("P1_EXIT")
        .unwrap_or_default()
        .parse::<i32>()
        .unwrap_or(0);
    if code != 0 {
        std::process::exit(code)
    }
}
